interpretation: Prediction from full text is expected when the text directly defines the value; this alone does not identify a padding artefact.
A padding-only flag identifies a possible nuisance cue, not proof that a reader/probe uses that cue.
Absence of a flag does not exclude nonlinear or relational padding shortcuts.
After registered results exist, join this sidecar by feature in the descriptive write-up; flag confirmations with padding_artefact_possible separately. Keep registered verdict unchanged.

method.auroc: pooled held-out decision_function predictions; present=1; fixed sign, no reversal
method.classifier: LogisticRegression C=1, solver=lbfgs, L2 default, fit_intercept=True, tol=1e-8, max_iter=2000
method.cv: LeaveOneGroupOut by template cluster; matched pair members always stay together
method.features: raw native Qwen token-ID unigram counts; no normalization, ngrams or metadata
method.flag: possible shortcut if padding-only OR full-prefix OOF AUROC >=0.8
method.padding: maximal leading repetition of the literal string pad<space>; excludes separator and carrier
method.padding_flag: padding artefact possible only if padding-only OOF AUROC >=0.8
method.population: all 168 frozen items per row, combining original dev/test for this separate diagnostic only
method.registered_verdict: unchanged; no registered metrics, gates, denominators or score joins modified
method.uncertainty: descriptive OOF point estimates and fold AUROCs; no confidence intervals computed
method.vocabulary: DictVectorizer fitted on training clusters only, separately for every fold/view/row
